messages:
ollie: dropped a photo dump — meet Marshmallow, the tub hog. refuses to leave the bubbles. :capybara: https://img.redwood.internal/ollie/marshmallow-a.jpg https://img.redwood.internal/ollie/marshmallow-b.jpg

jamie: that posture. he looks like he has opinions about your branching strategy. :joy:

devin: adorable and terrifying. does he clap when you merge?

ollie: only if you add release notes. also he demands eucalyptus towels on Mondays.

sanjay: vote: Marshmallow plush, sticker sheet, or office portrait? I want his silhouette on a mug. :coffee:

jamie: portrait > mug. its the eyes.

devin: sticker sheet please. Id slap one on my laptop and call it a performance optimization.

giphy-bot: https://giphy.com/gifs/capybara-relaxed-26n6WywJyh39n1pBu 

ollie: caption contest: posted his "approving your infra as code" face. best caption wins a tiny bag of plantain chips (he will judge).

sanjay: "when the canary pod stays green but the logs are yelling" :laughing:

jamie: "I calibrated the autoscaler to cuddle mode" :sparkles:

devin: "schedules meeting to cancel meeting" :rofl:

ollie: thanks for the laughs. will run the merch poll tomorrow and report results. Marshmallow requests extra treats for participation.
